findings.evidence: Lines 35–37 and 81–83 state Continuous and StrictAnti globally; every integral is over 0..T and σ₀ lies in Ioo 0 T. The comparison points σ₀ ± δ/2 lie inside that interval by the definition of δ. Mathlib/Order/Monotone/Defs.lean:106 defines StrictAntiOn.
findings.fix: Use ContinuousOn b (Icc 0 T), ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 T), and StrictAntiOn F (Icc 0 T) in both signatures (with a replacing b in the equality theorem). Restrict the proof's positivity and support arguments to that interval.
findings.issue: Both nonpos_of_forall_intervalIntegral_mul_contDiffBump_comp and eq_zero_of_forall_intervalIntegral_mul_contDiffBump_comp (line 81) require continuity and strict antitonicity on all of ℝ, preventing their use for reparametrizations defined regularly only along the relevant orbit segment.

summary: The bump-testing lemmas impose global regularity and monotonicity although their conclusions depend only on the integration interval.
